metadata.description: Industrial 30,033 BPSD Naphtha Hydrotreater reference plant reconstruction based on HPCL Visakh NHT Operating Manual and EIL engineering standards. Features 7-shell Combined Feed Exchanger train (72-E-01A..G), Charge Heater (72-F-01), Fixed-Bed Catalytic Reactor (72-R-01), Recycle Gas Compressor (72-K-01A/B), Wash Water Injection System, Stripper (72-C-01), and Naphtha Splitter (72-C-02) with full multi-display operational hierarchy and cross-display navigation.
metadata.author: NebuDCS Engineering Reference Library (HPCL/EIL Benchmark)
